account: A team at the Higher Colleges of Technology in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates, built Receipt Guardian, an app for children and families, with Mohamed Elsersy and Mariam Abdulwahab Alrayssi as contacts. The team reports that internal acceptance testing was complete and that a beta was in use by more than ten testers before public launch. Better financial literacy and spending habits remain intended outcomes. The team reports no measured change in either.
